```{r config}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## PATHS
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
desktop_path <- "~/Desktop/Ricerca/Lewy_R/SAA"
results_path <- file.path(desktop_path, "Results")
dir.create(results_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

f_clin  <- file.path(desktop_path, "datafreeze_lewy.xlsx")
f_bio   <- file.path(desktop_path, "BIOFLUIDS_CLINICAL.xlsx")
f_cat12 <- file.path(desktop_path, "CAT12_Hammers_DK_SPIN.xlsx")
## Optional: FreeSurfer normative Z from the VH pipeline. If present, it becomes
## the PRIMARY imaging pipeline and CAT12 becomes the sensitivity analysis.
f_aseg  <- file.path(desktop_path, "Z_ASEG_MERGED.xlsx")

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## MERGE OPTIONS
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
MAX_GAP_DAYS <- 365   # visit <-> sample; pairs beyond this are flagged
MAX_MRI_GAP  <- 730   # sample  <-> MRI

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## DATA-QUALITY GUARDS
## Values outside these ranges are set to NA and reported in section 2.
## This exists because the previous run produced e.g. Mayo = 21 (SD 62) on a
## 0-4 scale, which can only be sentinel codes (999) or a mis-picked column.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
SENTINELS <- c(-9, -99, -999, 888, 999, 9999, -1)

PLAUSIBLE <- tribble(
  ~var,                    ~lo, ~hi,
  "edad",                    18, 110,
  "EDUC",                     0,  30,
  "puntuaciones",             0,  30,   # MoCA total
  "visuoespacialp",           0,   5,

  "lenguajep",                0,   3,
  "abstraccionp",             0,   2,
  "orientacionp",             0,   6,
  "mis",                      0,  15,   # MoCA memory index
  "mayo_total_score",         0,   4,   # 4 dichotomous items
  "updrs1a_total_score",      0,  24,
  "updrs1b_total_score",      0,  28,
  "updrs2_total_score",       0,  52,
  "updrs3_total_score",       0, 132,
  "hoehn_yahr",               0,   5,
  "sppb_total_score",         0,  12,
  "sppb_subtotal1",           0,   4,
  "sppb_subtotal2",           0,   4,
  "sppb_subtotal3",           0,   4,
  "mta",                      0,   4,

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## ANALYTE PANEL — only assays with real coverage are tabulated.
## The previous run printed "NA (NA)" rows for sTREM2, SNAP-25, NPTX2, TDP-43
## and two plasma H0010 assays (n <= 1). MIN_PER_GROUP removes them.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

## assays reported on a log scale (right-skewed concentrations)
```

# Data loading and merge

```{r load}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## guess_max = Inf is essential. readxl types each column from the first 1000
## rows; in a long REDCap export the visit-level columns (UPDRS, MoCA, SPPB)
## are empty on the leading enrolment rows and would be typed <logical>,
## silently discarding every value below row 1000.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
read_x <- function(p) read_excel(p, guess_max = Inf, .name_repair = "minimal")

clin_raw <- read_x(f_clin)
bio_raw  <- read_x(f_bio)

## drop blank / duplicated column names produced by Excel
tidy_names <- function(df) {
  df <- df[, names(df) != "" & !is.na(names(df)), drop = FALSE]
  df[, !duplicated(names(df)), drop = FALSE]
}
clin_raw <- tidy_names(clin_raw); bio_raw <- tidy_names(bio_raw)

## ---- helpers --------------------------------------------------------------
norm_id <- function(x) {                       # 0012345 == 12345
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "NULL", "-", "0")] <- NA
  x <- gsub("[^0-9A-Z]", "", x)
  num <- !is.na(x) & grepl("^[0-9]+$", x)
  x[num] <- sub("^0+", "", x[num])
  x[!is.na(x) & x == ""] <- NA
  x
}

as_date_safe <- function(x) {                  # Date / POSIXct / serial / text
  if (inherits(x, "Date"))   return(x)
  if (inherits(x, "POSIXt")) return(as.Date(x))
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    out <- as.Date(rep(NA, length(x)))
    ok <- !is.na(x) & x > 10000 & x < 60000
    out[ok] <- as.Date(x[ok], origin = "1899-12-30"); return(out)
  }
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "NaN", "NULL", "-", "#N/A")] <- NA
  out <- as.Date(rep(NA, length(x)))
  ser <- !is.na(x) & grepl("^[0-9]{5}(\\.[0-9]+)?$", x)
  out[ser] <- as.Date(as.numeric(x[ser]), origin = "1899-12-30")
  for (f in c("%Y-%m-%d","%d/%m/%Y","%d-%m-%Y","%Y/%m/%d","%d.%m.%Y","%Y%m%d")) {
    todo <- !is.na(x) & is.na(out)
    if (!any(todo)) break
    out[todo] <- as.Date(substr(x[todo], 1, 10), format = f)
  }
  out[!is.na(out) & (out < as.Date("1900-01-01") | out > Sys.Date() + 365)] <- NA
  out
}

num_safe <- function(x) {                      # "<200", "1,5", " 12 "
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(x)
  v <- gsub("\\s", "", gsub("[<>=]", "", trimws(as.character(x))))
  v <- ifelse(grepl(",", v) & !grepl("\\.", v), gsub(",", ".", v), gsub(",", "", v))
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
}

has_col <- function(df, x) x %in% names(df)
```

```{r clinical-reshape}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## The REDCap export is LONG: subject-level fields sit on the enrolment event,
## visit-level fields on repeating instances. Collapsing without carrying the
## subject-level fields down loses either the core symptoms or the scores.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
nhc_col <- grep("^nhc$", names(clin_raw), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
stopifnot(!is.na(nhc_col))

clin <- clin_raw %>%
  mutate(NHC = norm_id(.data[[nhc_col]])) %>%
  filter(!is.na(NHC))

## Per-visit date. THE ORIGINAL SCRIPT USED visit_date_base_lewy, which is the
## baseline date (constant per subject) -- the "closest visit" rule was
## therefore never applied. visit_date is the per-instance column.
clin$visit_d <- as_date_safe(if (has_col(clin, "visit_date")) clin$visit_date else NA)
clin$visit_fallback <- as_date_safe(
  if (has_col(clin, "visit_date_base_lewy")) clin$visit_date_base_lewy else NA)
clin$visit_any <- coalesce(clin$visit_d, clin$visit_fallback)

## Columns that belong to a VISIT (never carried across rows)
visit_pat <- paste0("^(visit_date|redcap_event_instance|neurologist|visitdiagnosis|",
  "gds_visit|medication|hoehn_yahr|diagnostico_visita|updrs|sppb|mayo|zarit|",
  "lethargic|sleep_day|disorganized|staring|fecha|puntuaciones|resultado|mis$|",
  "visuoespacial|identificacion|atencion|lenguaje|abstraccion|orientacion|",
  "at_|len_|directos|inversos|letras|serie7|repeticion|fluidez|num_palab|",
  "rostro|seda|templo|clavel|rojo|speech|facial|rigidity|tapping|handmovements|",
  "pronation|legagility|arising|gait|freezing|postural|globalspont|kinetictremor|",
  "resttremor|constancy|dyskinesia|posture|movilidad|autocuidado|actividades|",
  "dolor_|ansiedad|depresion|termometro|a_[0-9]|d_[0-9]|resumen_|seguimiento)")
visit_cols   <- grep(visit_pat, names(clin), value = TRUE)
subject_cols <- setdiff(names(clin), c(visit_cols, "NHC", "visit_d",
                                       "visit_fallback", "visit_any"))

clin <- clin %>%
  group_by(NHC) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(subject_cols),
                ~ if (all(is.na(.x))) .x else coalesce(.x, .x[which(!is.na(.x))[1]]))) %>%
  ungroup()

clin_visits <- clin %>% filter(!is.na(visit_any)) %>%
  distinct(NHC, visit_any, .keep_all = TRUE)
clin_nodate <- clin %>% filter(!NHC %in% clin_visits$NHC) %>%
  distinct(NHC, .keep_all = TRUE)
clin_use <- bind_rows(clin_visits, clin_nodate)
```

```{r biofluid-merge}
bio <- bio_raw %>%
  mutate(NHC  = norm_id(.data[["NHC"]]),
         NHCb = if (has_col(bio_raw, "NHC2")) norm_id(.data[["NHC2"]]) else NA_character_) %>%
  mutate(NHC = coalesce(NHC, NHCb)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(NHC)) %>%
  distinct(across(everything()), .keep_all = TRUE)

bio$sample_d <- as_date_safe(bio$SAMPLEDATE)

join_args <- list(x = clin_use, y = bio, by = "NHC", suffix = c("_clin", "_bio"))
if (utils::packageVersion("dplyr") >= "1.1.0")
  join_args$relationship <- "many-to-many"

merged_df <- suppressWarnings(do.call(inner_join, join_args)) %>%
  mutate(date_diff = abs(as.numeric(sample_d - visit_any)),
         .rank = ifelse(is.na(date_diff), Inf, date_diff)) %>%
  group_by(NHC) %>%
  arrange(.rank, visit_any, sample_d, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(gap_over_limit = !is.na(date_diff) & date_diff > MAX_GAP_DAYS)

merge_note <- sprintf(
  paste("Clinical: %s subjects / %s dated visits. Biofluids: %s subjects / %s samples.",
        "Merged: %s subjects. Visit-sample gap: median %s d [IQR %s-%s], %s%% within 90 d,",
        "%s pair(s) beyond %s d."),
  n_distinct(clin$NHC), nrow(clin_visits), n_distinct(bio$NHC), nrow(bio),
  nrow(merged_df),
  round(median(merged_df$date_diff, na.rm = TRUE)),
  round(quantile(merged_df$date_diff, .25, na.rm = TRUE)),
  round(quantile(merged_df$date_diff, .75, na.rm = TRUE)),
  round(100 * mean(merged_df$date_diff <= 90, na.rm = TRUE)),
  sum(merged_df$gap_over_limit, na.rm = TRUE), MAX_GAP_DAYS)
cat(merge_note)
```

```{r gap-plot, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=3}
ggplot(merged_df %>% filter(!is.na(date_diff)), aes(date_diff)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#4C72B0", colour = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(90, MAX_GAP_DAYS), linetype = c("dashed", "dotted"),
             colour = c("#D55E00", "grey40")) +
  labs(title = "Interval between clinical visit and biofluid sampling",
       x = "|visit date − sample date| (days)", y = "Subjects",
       caption = "Dashed = 90 d; dotted = analysis limit")
```

# Data quality

```{r derive}
## ---- safe recoders --------------------------------------------------------
## ANCHORED patterns. The original used str_detect(x, "pos|1"), which matches
## any string containing a "1" (e.g. "10", "0.15", a plate code).
recode_saa <- function(x) {
  v <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(v))
  out[grepl("^(0|neg|negative|negativo|negativa)$", v)] <- "Negative"
  out[grepl("^(1|pos|positive|positivo|positiva)$", v)] <- "Positive"
  out[grepl("^(2|3|9|ind|indet|indeterminate|inconclusive|dudoso|equivocal)$", v)] <-
    "Indeterminate"
  factor(out, levels = c("Negative", "Positive", "Indeterminate"))
}

recode_yesno <- function(x) {
  v <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  v[v %in% c("", "na", "null", "-", "9", "99", "unknown", "desconocido", "nd")] <- NA
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(v))
  out[grepl("^(0|no|n|absent|ausente|negative|negativo|normal|false)$", v)] <- "No"
  out[grepl("^(1|2|yes|y|si|s[ií]|present|presente|positive|positivo|abnormal|anormal|patologico|true)$", v)] <- "Yes"
  factor(out, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
}

## Free-text/multi-level fields that must be collapsed rather than shown raw.
## The previous run printed DaT-SCAN and PSG with their full level sets
## (including "Scheduled", "NA", "RBD+SAHS+PLM"), producing an uninterpretable
## chi-squared across administrative categories.
recode_datscan <- function(x) {
  v <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(v))
  out[grepl("normal", v) & !grepl("abnormal|anormal|patolog", v)] <- "Normal"
  out[grepl("abnormal|anormal|patolog|altered|alterado", v)] <- "Abnormal"
  factor(out, levels = c("Normal", "Abnormal"))
}
recode_psg <- function(x) {                 # RBD present on PSG, yes/no
  v <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(v))
  out[grepl("no rbd|sin rbd", v)] <- "No"
  out[grepl("rbd", v) & !grepl("no rbd|sin rbd", v)] <- "Yes"
  out[grepl("scheduled|pending|programad|^na$|^$", v)] <- NA
  factor(out, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
}

clamp <- function(x, lo, hi, label) {
  v <- num_safe(x)
  v[v %in% SENTINELS] <- NA
  bad <- !is.na(v) & (v < lo | v > hi)
  if (any(bad)) qc_log[[label]] <<- sum(bad)
  v[bad] <- NA
  v
}

qc_log <- list()

analytic_df <- merged_df
analytic_df$saa3_raw <- if (has_col(analytic_df, "CSF_ALPHASYN_SAA03"))
  recode_saa(analytic_df$CSF_ALPHASYN_SAA03) else factor(rep(NA, nrow(analytic_df)),
                                                         levels = c("Negative","Positive"))

## apply plausibility limits
for (i in seq_len(nrow(PLAUSIBLE))) {
  vn <- PLAUSIBLE$var[i]
  if (has_col(analytic_df, vn))
    analytic_df[[vn]] <- clamp(analytic_df[[vn]], PLAUSIBLE$lo[i],
                               PLAUSIBLE$hi[i], vn)
}

analytic_df <- analytic_df %>%
  mutate(
    SEX = factor(ifelse(grepl("^(f|female|mujer|femenino)$", tolower(trimws(SEX))),
                        "Female",
                 ifelse(grepl("^(m|male|hombre|var|masculino)", tolower(trimws(SEX))),
                        "Male", NA)), levels = c("Female", "Male")),

    saa_local_pos  = recode_saa(CSF_ALPHASYN_SAA02),
    saa_munich_pos = recode_saa(CSF_ALPHASYN_SAA01),
    saa_third      = saa3_raw,

    ## Own-site result preferred, Munich as fallback. The original rule coded
    ## ANY positive as Positive, which silently resolved every discordant pair
    ## in favour of Positive -- incompatible with the concordance analysis.
    saa_any_pos = factor(coalesce(as.character(saa_local_pos),
                                  as.character(saa_munich_pos)),
                         levels = c("Negative", "Positive", "Indeterminate")),

    A_clean = factor(case_when(
      grepl("^(1|pos|positive|positivo|a\\+|\\+)$", tolower(trimws(ASTATUS))) ~ "A+",
      grepl("^(0|neg|negative|negativo|a-|-)$",     tolower(trimws(ASTATUS))) ~ "A-"),
      levels = c("A-", "A+")),
    T_clean = factor(case_when(
      grepl("^(1|pos|positive|positivo|t\\+|\\+)$", tolower(trimws(TSTATUS))) ~ "T+",
      grepl("^(0|neg|negative|negativo|t-|-)$",     tolower(trimws(TSTATUS))) ~ "T-"),
      levels = c("T-", "T+")),
    AT_profile = factor(if_else(is.na(A_clean) | is.na(T_clean), NA_character_,
                                paste0(A_clean, " / ", T_clean)),
                        levels = c("A- / T-", "A- / T+", "A+ / T-", "A+ / T+")),

    ## APOE: genotype string -> carrier. Guarded against a dosage-coded column.
    apoe4_carrier = {
      g <- gsub("[^0-9]", "", as.character(APOE))
      factor(ifelse(is.na(g) | nchar(g) < 2, NA,
                    ifelse(grepl("4", g), "Yes", "No")), levels = c("No", "Yes"))
    },

    hallucinations = recode_yesno(hallucinations),
    fluctuations   = recode_yesno(fluctuations),
    rbdclinical    = recode_yesno(rbdclinical),
    parkinsonism   = recode_yesno(parkinsonism),
    hyposmia       = recode_yesno(hyposmia),
    dysautonomia   = recode_yesno(dysautonomia),
    repeatedfalls  = recode_yesno(repeatedfalls),
    hypersomnia    = recode_yesno(hypersomnia),
    neurolepticsens= recode_yesno(neurolepticsens),
    datscan_bin    = recode_datscan(datscan),
    psg_rbd        = recode_psg(psg),

    ## age at sampling beats a stored age from an unrelated timepoint
    age_at_sample = {
      a <- as.numeric(sample_d - as_date_safe(fnac)) / 365.25
      a[!is.na(a) & (a < 18 | a > 110)] <- NA
      coalesce(a, num_safe(edad), num_safe(AGE))
    },

    n_core = rowSums(cbind(hallucinations == "Yes", fluctuations == "Yes",
                           rbdclinical == "Yes", parkinsonism == "Yes"), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_core = ifelse(rowSums(!is.na(cbind(hallucinations, fluctuations,
                                         rbdclinical, parkinsonism))) == 0, NA, n_core),

    ## UPDRS total: NA unless all four parts are present (partial sums are not
    ## comparable across subjects)
    total_updrs = ifelse(
      is.na(updrs1a_total_score) | is.na(updrs1b_total_score) |
      is.na(updrs2_total_score)  | is.na(updrs3_total_score), NA,
      updrs1a_total_score + updrs1b_total_score +
      updrs2_total_score + updrs3_total_score)
  )
```

```{r pd-phenotype}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Motor phenotype (Jankovic): mean tremor / mean akinetic-rigid, from the
## MDS-UPDRS III items. Absent from the original script.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
TREM <- c("posturaltremorr","posturaltremorl","kinetictremorr","kinetictremorl",
          "resttremorrue","resttremorlue","resttremorrle","resttremorlle",
          "resttremorlipjaw","constancy")
AKRI <- c("speech","facialexpression","rigidityneck","rigidityrue","rigiditylue",
          "rigidityrle","rigiditylle","tappingrue","tappinglue","handmovementsr",
          "handmovementsl","pronationsupinationr","pronationsupinationl",
          "tappingrle","tappinglle","legagilityr","legagilityl","arising","gait",
          "freezing","posturalstability","posture","globalspontaneityl")

item_matrix <- function(df, items) {
  got <- intersect(items, names(df))
  if (!length(got)) return(list(m = NULL, used = character()))
  m <- sapply(got, function(cc) {
    v <- num_safe(df[[cc]]); v[!is.na(v) & (v < 0 | v > 4)] <- NA; v
  })
  list(m = as.matrix(m), used = got)
}
tr <- item_matrix(analytic_df, TREM); ak <- item_matrix(analytic_df, AKRI)

mean_min <- function(m, k) {
  if (is.null(m)) return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(analytic_df)))
  out <- rowMeans(m, na.rm = TRUE); out[rowSums(!is.na(m)) < k] <- NA_real_; out
}
analytic_df$tremor_score  <- mean_min(tr$m, max(3, length(tr$used) %/% 2))
analytic_df$akrigid_score <- mean_min(ak$m, max(5, length(ak$used) %/% 2))
analytic_df <- analytic_df %>%
  mutate(td_ar_ratio = ifelse(!is.na(akrigid_score) & akrigid_score > 0,
                              tremor_score / akrigid_score, NA_real_),
         pd_phenotype = factor(case_when(
           is.na(td_ar_ratio)   ~ NA_character_,
           td_ar_ratio >= 1.0   ~ "Tremor-dominant",
           td_ar_ratio <= 0.8   ~ "Akinetic-rigid",
           TRUE                 ~ "Mixed"),
           levels = c("Akinetic-rigid", "Mixed", "Tremor-dominant")))

cat(sprintf("UPDRS-III items found: %d/%d tremor, %d/%d akinetic-rigid. Phenotype classifiable in %d subjects.",
            length(tr$used), length(TREM), length(ak$used), length(AKRI),
            sum(!is.na(analytic_df$pd_phenotype))))
```

```{r cohorts}
  nrow(df_both), sum(df_both$saa_any_pos=="Positive"), sum(df_both$saa_any_pos=="Negative"),
  n_indet))
```

# Clinical demographics

```{r table-helpers}
## ---- effect sizes ---------------------------------------------------------
smd_value <- function(x, g) {
  g <- droplevels(factor(g)); if (nlevels(g) != 2) return(NA_real_)
  i1 <- g == levels(g)[1]; i2 <- g == levels(g)[2]
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    a <- x[i1]; a <- a[!is.na(a)]; b <- x[i2]; b <- b[!is.na(b)]
    if (length(a) < 2 || length(b) < 2) return(NA_real_)
    den <- sqrt((var(a) + var(b)) / 2)
    return(if (!is.finite(den) || den == 0) NA_real_ else (mean(a) - mean(b)) / den)
  }
  f <- droplevels(factor(x)); k <- nlevels(f); if (k < 2) return(NA_real_)
  p1 <- as.numeric(prop.table(table(f[i1])))[-k]
  p2 <- as.numeric(prop.table(table(f[i2])))[-k]
  if (anyNA(p1) || anyNA(p2)) return(NA_real_)
  if (k == 2) {
    den <- sqrt((p1*(1-p1) + p2*(1-p2)) / 2)
    return(if (!is.finite(den) || den == 0) NA_real_ else (p1 - p2) / den)
  }
  S <- ((diag(p1, k-1) - outer(p1,p1)) + (diag(p2, k-1) - outer(p2,p2))) / 2
  inv <- try(solve(S), silent = TRUE); if (inherits(inv,"try-error")) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(sqrt(max(0, t(p1-p2) %*% inv %*% (p1-p2))))
}

fn_smd <- function(data, variable, by, ...) {
  v <- smd_value(data[[variable]], data[[by]])
  if (is.na(v)) NA_character_ else sprintf("%.2f", v)
}

## Mean difference (continuous) or risk difference (binary), with 95% CI.
## Supplied as a custom stat rather than via add_difference(), which would
## collide with add_p() over the p.value column.
fn_md <- function(data, variable, by, ...) {
  x <- data[[variable]]; g <- droplevels(factor(data[[by]]))
  if (nlevels(g) != 2) return(NA_character_)
  i1 <- g == levels(g)[1]; i2 <- g == levels(g)[2]
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    a <- x[i1]; b <- x[i2]
    if (sum(!is.na(a)) < 2 || sum(!is.na(b)) < 2) return(NA_character_)
    tt <- try(t.test(a, b), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(tt, "try-error")) return(NA_character_)
    return(sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", unname(tt$estimate[1] - tt$estimate[2]),
                   tt$conf.int[1], tt$conf.int[2]))
  }
  f <- droplevels(factor(x)); if (nlevels(f) != 2) return(NA_character_)
  hi <- levels(f)[2]
  x1 <- sum(f[i1] == hi, na.rm = TRUE); n1 <- sum(!is.na(f[i1]))
  x2 <- sum(f[i2] == hi, na.rm = TRUE); n2 <- sum(!is.na(f[i2]))
  if (n1 < 2 || n2 < 2) return(NA_character_)
  pt <- try(prop.test(c(x1, x2), c(n1, n2), correct = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(pt, "try-error")) return(NA_character_)
  sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f, %.1f)", 100*(x1/n1 - x2/n2),
          100*pt$conf.int[1], 100*pt$conf.int[2])
}

## A tbl_summary module: n, median [IQR] or n(%), non-parametric p, difference, SMD.
## Continuous tests are rank-based; the previous script used Welch t-tests on
## ordinal (MTA, Fazekas) and heavily skewed (GFAP, NfL) variables.
mod_cont <- function(data, vars, labels, group_var) {
  data %>% select(all_of(vars), all_of(group_var)) %>%
    tbl_summary(by = all_of(group_var), missing = "no",
                type = list(everything() ~ "continuous"),
                label = labels,
                statistic = list(everything() ~ "{median} [{p25}, {p75}]"),
                digits = list(everything() ~ 1)) %>%
    add_n() %>%
    add_p(test = everything() ~ "wilcox.test",
          pvalue_fun = ~ style_pvalue(.x, digits = 3)) %>%
    add_stat(fns = everything() ~ fn_md) %>%
    modify_header(add_stat_1 = "**Diff. (95% CI)**") %>%
    add_stat(fns = everything() ~ fn_smd) %>%
    modify_header(add_stat_2 = "**SMD**") %>%
    bold_p(t = 0.05)
}

mod_cat <- function(data, vars, labels, group_var) {
  data %>% select(all_of(vars), all_of(group_var)) %>%
    tbl_summary(by = all_of(group_var), missing = "no", label = labels) %>%
    add_n() %>%
    add_p(test = everything() ~ "fisher.test",
          pvalue_fun = ~ style_pvalue(.x, digits = 3)) %>%
    add_stat(fns = everything() ~ fn_md) %>%
    modify_header(add_stat_1 = "**Diff. (95% CI)**") %>%
    add_stat(fns = everything() ~ fn_smd) %>%
    modify_header(add_stat_2 = "**SMD**") %>%
    bold_p(t = 0.05)
}

keep_usable <- function(data, vars, min_n = 5) {
  vars[vapply(vars, function(v) {
    if (!has_col(data, v)) return(FALSE)
    x <- data[[v]]
    sum(!is.na(x)) >= min_n && length(unique(x[!is.na(x)])) > 1
  }, logical(1))]
}

format_gt_table <- function(tbl) {
  as_gt(tbl) %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_fill(color = "#E0E0E0"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
              locations = cells_row_groups())
}
```

```{r clinical-table}
LAB <- c(
  SEX="Female sex", apoe4_carrier="APOE ε4 carrier", age_at_sample="Age at sampling (y)",
  EDUC="Education (y)", puntuaciones="MoCA total", visuoespacialp="  Visuospatial/executive",
  identificacionp="  Naming", atencionp="  Attention", lenguajep="  Language",
  abstraccionp="  Abstraction", orientacionp="  Orientation", mis="  Memory index",
  total_updrs="MDS-UPDRS total (IA+IB+II+III)", updrs1a_total_score="  Part IA",
  updrs1b_total_score="  Part IB", updrs2_total_score="  Part II",
  updrs3_total_score="  Part III", hoehn_yahr="Hoehn & Yahr",
  pd_phenotype="Motor phenotype", td_ar_ratio="Tremor / akinetic-rigid ratio",
  hallucinations="Visual hallucinations", fluctuations="Cognitive fluctuations",
  rbdclinical="Clinical RBD", parkinsonism="Parkinsonism", n_core="Number of core features",
  hyposmia="Hyposmia", dysautonomia="Dysautonomia", repeatedfalls="Repeated falls",
  hypersomnia="Hypersomnia", neurolepticsens="Neuroleptic sensitivity",
  mayo_total_score="Mayo Fluctuations Scale", sppb_total_score="SPPB total",
  datscan_bin="DaT-SCAN abnormal", psg_rbd="PSG-confirmed RBD",
  A_clean="Amyloid status", AT_profile="A/T profile", mta="MTA score", fazekas="Fazekas score")

lab_list <- function(v) setNames(as.list(unname(LAB[v])), v) %>%
  { imap(., function(l, n) as.formula(paste0("`", n, "` ~ '", l, "'"))) } %>% unname()

build_clinical <- function(data, group_var) {
  blocks <- list(
    list(t="cat",  v=c("SEX","apoe4_carrier"),                      h="Demographics"),
    list(t="cont", v=c("age_at_sample","EDUC"),                      h="Demographics"),
    list(t="cont", v=c("puntuaciones","visuoespacialp","identificacionp","atencionp",
                       "lenguajep","abstraccionp","orientacionp","mis"),
                                                                     h="Cognition (MoCA)"),
    list(t="cont", v=c("total_updrs","updrs1a_total_score","updrs1b_total_score",
                       "updrs2_total_score","updrs3_total_score","hoehn_yahr"),
                                                                     h="Motor (MDS-UPDRS)"),
    list(t="cat",  v="pd_phenotype",                                 h="Motor phenotype"),
    list(t="cat",  v=c("hallucinations","fluctuations","rbdclinical","parkinsonism"),
                                                                     h="Core features"),
    list(t="cont", v="n_core",                                       h="Core features"),
    list(t="cat",  v=c("hyposmia","dysautonomia","repeatedfalls","hypersomnia",
                       "neurolepticsens"),                           h="Supportive features"),
    list(t="cont", v=c("mayo_total_score","sppb_total_score"),        h="Scales"),
    list(t="cat",  v=c("datscan_bin","psg_rbd","A_clean","AT_profile"), h="Biomarkers & imaging"),
    list(t="cont", v=c("mta","fazekas"),                             h="Biomarkers & imaging"))

  built <- list(); heads <- character()
  for (b in blocks) {
    vv <- keep_usable(data, b$v)
    if (!length(vv)) next
    tb <- if (b$t == "cont") mod_cont(data, vv, lab_list(vv), group_var)
          else               mod_cat (data, vv, lab_list(vv), group_var)
    built <- c(built, list(tb)); heads <- c(heads, b$h)
  }
  tbl_stack(built, group_header = heads) %>%
    modify_header(label ~ "**Variable**") %>% bold_labels()
}
```

```{r analyte-panel}
PANEL <- list(
  `CSF core AD` = c(CSF_ABRATIO="Aβ42/40 ratio", CSF_ABETA42_E0100="Aβ42",
                    CSF_ABETA40_E0350="Aβ40", CSF_PTAU181_E0100="p-tau181",
                    CSF_TTAU_A0010="t-tau"),
  `CSF glial / synaptic` = c(CSF_NFL_E0600="NfL", CSF_GFAP_S0120="GFAP",
                    CSF_YKL40_E0500="YKL-40", CSF_STREM2_E2100="sTREM2",
                    CSF_SNAP25_S0500="SNAP-25", CSF_NPTX2_E0050="NPTX2",
                    CSF_TOTALTDP43_E0710="Total TDP-43"),
  `Plasma` = c(PLASMA_AB42_AB40_RATIO_H0010="Aβ42/40 ratio",
                    PLASMA_PTAU217_S0217="p-tau217 (S0217)",
                    PLASMA_PTAU217_H0010="p-tau217 (H0010)",
                    PLASMA_GFAP_S0120="GFAP", PLASMA_NFLIGHT_S0100="NfL"))

## Coverage gate: drop assays without MIN_PER_GROUP observations in BOTH groups.
coverage_ok <- function(data, v, group_var) {
  if (!has_col(data, v)) return(FALSE)
  x <- num_safe(data[[v]]); g <- data[[group_var]]
  all(tapply(!is.na(x), g, sum, default = 0) >= MIN_PER_GROUP)
}

build_analytes <- function(data, group_var) {
  built <- list(); heads <- character()
  for (pn in names(PANEL)) {
    vs <- names(PANEL[[pn]])
    vs <- vs[vapply(vs, coverage_ok, logical(1), data = data, group_var = group_var)]
    if (!length(vs)) next
    dd <- data %>% mutate(across(all_of(vs), num_safe))
    labs <- setNames(as.list(unname(PANEL[[pn]][vs])), vs) %>%
      imap(function(l, n) as.formula(paste0("`", n, "` ~ '", l, "'"))) %>% unname()
    tb <- dd %>% select(all_of(vs), all_of(group_var)) %>%
      tbl_summary(by = all_of(group_var), missing = "no",
                  type = list(everything() ~ "continuous"),
                  label = labs,
                  statistic = list(everything() ~ "{median} [{p25}, {p75}]")) %>%
      add_n() %>%
      add_p(test = everything() ~ "wilcox.test",
            pvalue_fun = ~ style_pvalue(.x, digits = 3)) %>%
      add_stat(fns = everything() ~ fn_smd) %>%
      modify_header(add_stat_1 = "**SMD**")
    built <- c(built, list(tb)); heads <- c(heads, pn)
  }
  if (!length(built)) return(NULL)
  tbl_stack(built, group_header = heads) %>%
    bold_p(t = 0.05) %>%
    modify_header(label ~ "**Biomarker**") %>% bold_labels()
}
```

```{r analyte-tables}
    tab_source_note(sprintf("Assays with <%d observations per group are omitted. q = Benjamini-Hochberg across the whole panel.", MIN_PER_GROUP))
  gtsave(gt_analy_saa2, file.path(results_path, "Analytical_SantPau.html"))
```

```{r panel-fdr}
## FDR across the whole biomarker panel, computed independently of gtsummary
## (add_q is not available on stacked tables in every version).
panel_vars <- unlist(lapply(PANEL, names), use.names = FALSE)
panel_fdr <- map_dfr(panel_vars, function(v) {
  if (!has_col(df_both, v)) return(NULL)
  x <- num_safe(df_both[[v]]); g <- df_both$saa_any_pos
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(g)
  n1 <- sum(ok & g == "Positive"); n0 <- sum(ok & g == "Negative")
  if (n1 < MIN_PER_GROUP || n0 < MIN_PER_GROUP) return(NULL)
  w <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(x[g == "Positive"], x[g == "Negative"],
                                    exact = FALSE))
  tibble(Biomarker = v, n_pos = n1, n_neg = n0,
         SMD = round(smd_value(x, g), 3), p = w$p.value)
})
if (nrow(panel_fdr)) {
  panel_fdr <- panel_fdr %>% mutate(q_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH"),
                                    p = signif(p, 3), q_BH = signif(q_BH, 3)) %>%
    arrange(p)
  write.csv(panel_fdr, file.path(results_path, "Biomarker_panel_FDR.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  kable(panel_fdr, caption = sprintf(
    "Combined cohort: FDR across all %d panel biomarkers with adequate coverage.",
    nrow(panel_fdr))) %>%
    kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped","condensed"))
} else cat("No panel biomarker reaches the coverage threshold.")
```

```{r synergy}
## The original stratified SAA+ subjects by median plasma p-tau217 and then
## tested plasma p-tau217 as an outcome -- circular by construction. It is kept
## here only as a labelled manipulation check, and every cell reports n.
saa_pos <- analytic_df %>%
  filter(saa_any_pos == "Positive", !is.na(num_safe(PLASMA_PTAU217_S0217))) %>%
  mutate(p217 = num_safe(PLASMA_PTAU217_S0217),
         ad_copath_group = factor(ifelse(p217 > median(p217, na.rm = TRUE),
                                         "High p-tau217", "Low p-tau217"),
                                  levels = c("Low p-tau217", "High p-tau217")))

if (nrow(saa_pos) >= 2 * MIN_PER_GROUP) {
  syn_vars <- keep_usable(saa_pos %>% mutate(across(any_of(
      c("CSF_GFAP_S0120","PLASMA_GFAP_S0120","CSF_NFL_E0600",
        "PLASMA_NFLIGHT_S0100")), num_safe)),
      c("CSF_GFAP_S0120","PLASMA_GFAP_S0120","CSF_NFL_E0600","PLASMA_NFLIGHT_S0100",
        "puntuaciones","total_updrs","age_at_sample"), min_n = 2 * MIN_PER_GROUP)
  if (length(syn_vars)) {
    gt_synergy <- saa_pos %>%
      mutate(across(any_of(syn_vars), num_safe)) %>%
      select(all_of(syn_vars), ad_copath_group) %>%
      tbl_summary(by = ad_copath_group, missing = "no",
                  type = list(everything() ~ "continuous"),
                  statistic = list(everything() ~ "{median} [{p25}, {p75}]")) %>%
      add_n() %>% add_p(test = everything() ~ "wilcox.test") %>%
      add_q(method = "BH") %>% bold_p(t = 0.05) %>%
      modify_header(label ~ "**Metric**") %>% bold_labels() %>%
      as_gt() %>%
      tab_header(title = md("**SAA-positive subjects stratified by plasma p-tau217**"),
                 subtitle = sprintf("Median split, n = %d. Exploratory.", nrow(saa_pos)))
    gtsave(gt_synergy, file.path(results_path, "Synergy_SAA_Positive.html"))
    gt_synergy
  } else cat("No variable reaches the minimum n for this stratification.")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("Only %d SAA-positive subjects have plasma p-tau217 — too few to stratify (need %d).",
              nrow(saa_pos), 2 * MIN_PER_GROUP))
}
```

# UPDRS III and physical performance (SPPB)

```{r updrs-sppb}
## The original showed a scatter plot only. Correlations are quantified here,
## per group, with a Fisher r-to-z test of whether they differ.
cor_one <- function(dat, lab) {
  x <- num_safe(dat$updrs3_total_score); y <- num_safe(dat$sppb_total_score)
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y); n <- sum(ok)
  if (n < 5) return(tibble(Group = lab, n = n, rho = NA, p = NA, Pearson_r = NA))
  sp <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
  pe <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "pearson"))
  tibble(Group = lab, n = n, rho = round(unname(sp$estimate), 3),
         p = signif(sp$p.value, 3), Pearson_r = round(unname(pe$estimate), 3))
}
cor_res <- bind_rows(
  cor_one(df_both %>% filter(saa_any_pos == "Positive"), "SAA positive"),
  cor_one(df_both %>% filter(saa_any_pos == "Negative"), "SAA negative"),
  cor_one(df_both, "All (combined)"),
  cor_one(df_saa2, "All (Sant Pau)"))

a <- cor_res[1,]; b <- cor_res[2,]
fisher_line <- if (!is.na(a$rho) && !is.na(b$rho) && a$n > 3 && b$n > 3) {
  z <- (atanh(a$rho) - atanh(b$rho)) / sqrt(1/(a$n-3) + 1/(b$n-3))
  sprintf("Fisher r-to-z, SAA+ vs SAA−: z = %.2f, p = %.3f", z, 2*pnorm(-abs(z)))
} else "Too few complete pairs to compare the two correlations."

kable(cor_res, caption = paste("UPDRS III vs SPPB.", fisher_line)) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped","condensed"))
write.csv(cor_res, file.path(results_path, "Correlation_UPDRS_SPPB.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# SAA assay concordance

```{r concordance}
both_assays <- analytic_df %>%
  filter(saa_munich_pos %in% c("Negative","Positive"),
         saa_local_pos  %in% c("Negative","Positive")) %>%
  mutate(saa_munich_pos = droplevels(saa_munich_pos),
         saa_local_pos  = droplevels(saa_local_pos),
         concordant = saa_munich_pos == saa_local_pos)

ct <- table(Munich = both_assays$saa_munich_pos, SantPau = both_assays$saa_local_pos)

conc_txt <- if (sum(ct) >= 2 && all(dim(ct) == c(2,2))) {
  agree <- sum(diag(ct)) / sum(ct)
  pe <- sum(rowSums(ct) * colSums(ct)) / sum(ct)^2
  kap <- (agree - pe) / (1 - pe)
  se  <- sqrt(agree * (1 - agree) / (sum(ct) * (1 - pe)^2))
  mc  <- suppressWarnings(mcnemar.test(ct, correct = TRUE))
  sprintf(paste("n = %d subjects have both assays. Agreement %.1f%% (%d/%d).",
                "Cohen's κ = %.2f (95%% CI %.2f–%.2f). McNemar p = %.3f.",
                "Munich+/SantPau− = %d; Munich−/SantPau+ = %d."),
          sum(ct), 100*agree, sum(diag(ct)), sum(ct), kap,
          kap - 1.96*se, kap + 1.96*se, mc$p.value,
          ct["Positive","Negative"], ct["Negative","Positive"])
} else sprintf("Only %d subjects have both assays — no concordance statistics computed.", sum(ct))

as.data.frame.matrix(ct) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("Munich (SAA01)") %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "Munich (SAA01)") %>%
  tab_header(title = md("**SAA concordance — subjects tested on both assays**"),
             subtitle = conc_txt) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Sant Pau (SAA02)", columns = everything()) %>%
  cols_align("center") %>% opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "blue")
```

```{r discordant-listing}
## Which subjects disagree, with the third assay and AD biomarkers to arbitrate.
disc <- both_assays %>% filter(!concordant) %>%
  transmute(NHC, visit = visit_any, sample = sample_d, gap_d = date_diff,
            Munich = saa_munich_pos, SantPau = saa_local_pos, Third = saa_third,
            AT_profile, datscan_bin, psg_rbd, rbdclinical, parkinsonism,
            hallucinations)
if (nrow(disc)) {
  write.csv(disc, file.path(results_path, "SAA_discordant_subjects.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  kable(disc, caption = "Discordant subjects — review individually.") %>%
    kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped","condensed"),
                  font_size = 11)
} else cat("No discordant pairs.")
```

# Exploratory analyte screen

```{r analyte-screen}
## Hypothesis-generating scan across every CSF/plasma/serum assay with adequate
## coverage, rather than a hand-picked panel.
cand <- grep("^(CSF_|PLASMA_|SERUM_)", names(analytic_df), value = TRUE)
cand <- cand[!grepl("ALPHASYN|SAA[0-9]|PROTEOMICS|METABOLOMICS|SAMPLECODE|STOCK|VOLUME|PROTOCOL|SAMPLETIME|CHRONOLOGY", cand)]

screen_one <- function(cc, dat, gv) {
  v <- num_safe(dat[[cc]]); g <- dat[[gv]]
  ok <- !is.na(v) & !is.na(g); v <- v[ok]; g <- droplevels(factor(g[ok]))
  if (nlevels(g) != 2) return(NULL)
  n1 <- sum(g == "Positive"); n0 <- sum(g == "Negative")
  if (n1 < MIN_PER_GROUP || n0 < MIN_PER_GROUP) return(NULL)
  a <- v[g == "Positive"]; b <- v[g == "Negative"]
  w <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(a, b, exact = FALSE))
  U <- unname(w$statistic); auc <- U / (n1 * n0)
  tibble(Analyte = cc, n_pos = n1, n_neg = n0,
         median_pos = signif(median(a), 4), median_neg = signif(median(b), 4),
         fold_change = if (median(b) != 0) signif(median(a)/median(b), 3) else NA,
         rank_biserial = round(2*U/(n1*n0) - 1, 3),
         AUC = round(max(auc, 1-auc), 3),
         Direction = ifelse(auc >= .5, "higher in SAA+", "higher in SAA−"),
         p = w$p.value)
}

screen <- map_dfr(cand, screen_one, dat = df_both, gv = "saa_any_pos")
if (nrow(screen)) {
  screen <- screen %>% mutate(q_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH"),
                              p = signif(p, 4), q_BH = signif(q_BH, 4)) %>%
    arrange(p)
  write.csv(screen, file.path(results_path, "Analyte_screen.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  kable(head(screen, 20),
        caption = sprintf("Top 20 of %d analytes tested (≥%d per group). Exploratory: no adjustment for age, sex, APOE or batch.",
                          nrow(screen), MIN_PER_GROUP)) %>%
    kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped","condensed"),
                  font_size = 11)
} else cat(sprintf("No analyte reaches %d observations per group.", MIN_PER_GROUP))
```

# Imaging

```{r imaging-load}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## PIPELINE CHOICE
## The VH cortical-thickness work found that a CAT12/Hammers thalamic effect did
## not reproduce in FreeSurfer. That comparison, however, fitted the two
## pipelines on DIFFERENT subject sets, so it showed a sample difference as much
## as a pipeline difference. Here both pipelines are run on the SAME subjects
## whenever the FreeSurfer file is available, which is the only way to separate
## the two explanations.
## Volumes are z-scored within the analysis sample so that structures of very
## different size are comparable on one forest-plot axis (the previous version
## plotted raw volumes: thalamus ~7 mL against accumbens ~0.5 mL).
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
have_cat12 <- file.exists(f_cat12)
have_aseg  <- file.exists(f_aseg)

STRUCTS <- c("Thalamus","Caudate","Putamen","Pallidum","Hippocampus","Amygdala","Accumbens")
## A priori family for SAA positivity: nigrostriatal / basal-forebrain targets.
APRIORI <- c("Putamen","Caudate","Amygdala")

cat12 <- NULL
if (have_cat12) {
  cat12 <- read_x(f_cat12) %>% tidy_names() %>%
    mutate(NHC = norm_id(NHC),
           MRI_DATE_D = as_date_safe(MRI_DATE))
  hm <- c(Thalamus="thalamus", Caudate="caudate.nucleus", Putamen="putamen",
          Pallidum="pallidum", Hippocampus="TL.hippocampus",
          Amygdala="TL.amygdala", Accumbens="nucleus.accumbens")
  for (s in names(hm)) {
    l <- paste0("MRI_hammers_Vgm_", hm[[s]], ".L")
    r <- paste0("MRI_hammers_Vgm_", hm[[s]], ".R")
    cat12[[paste0("CAT_", s)]] <- if (all(c(l, r) %in% names(cat12)))
      rowMeans(cbind(num_safe(cat12[[l]]), num_safe(cat12[[r]])), na.rm = FALSE) else NA_real_
  }
  cat12$TIV_cat <- num_safe(cat12$MRI_TIV)
}

aseg <- NULL
if (have_aseg) {
  aseg <- read_x(f_aseg) %>% tidy_names() %>%
    mutate(NHC = norm_id(sub("_.*$", "", SubjectID)),
           MRI_DATE_D = as_date_safe(sub("^[^_]*_", "", SubjectID)))
  fs <- c(Thalamus="thal", Caudate="caud", Putamen="put", Pallidum="pal",
          Hippocampus="hippo", Amygdala="amyg", Accumbens="accumb")
  for (s in names(fs)) {
    l <- paste0("L", fs[[s]]); r <- paste0("R", fs[[s]])
    aseg[[paste0("FS_", s)]] <- if (all(c(l, r) %in% names(aseg)))
      rowMeans(cbind(num_safe(aseg[[l]]), num_safe(aseg[[r]])), na.rm = FALSE) else NA_real_
  }
}

attach_imaging <- function(base, img, prefix, date_col = "MRI_DATE_D") {
  if (is.null(img)) return(NULL)
  keep <- c("NHC", date_col, grep(paste0("^", prefix), names(img), value = TRUE),
            intersect(c("TIV_cat", "MRI_TIV"), names(img)))
  ja <- list(x = base %>% select(NHC, sample_d, visit_any, saa_any_pos,
                                 SEX, age_at_sample, any_of("MRI_TIV")),
             y = img %>% select(all_of(keep)), by = "NHC")
  if (utils::packageVersion("dplyr") >= "1.1.0") ja$relationship <- "many-to-many"
  suppressWarnings(do.call(inner_join, ja)) %>%
    mutate(mri_gap = abs(as.numeric(.data[[date_col]] - sample_d))) %>%
    group_by(NHC) %>% arrange(ifelse(is.na(mri_gap), Inf, mri_gap), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
    filter(is.na(mri_gap) | mri_gap <= MAX_MRI_GAP)
}

img_cat <- attach_imaging(df_both, cat12, "CAT_")
img_fs  <- attach_imaging(df_both, aseg,  "FS_")
```

```{r imaging-fit}
## TIV column resolved per data frame; if none is present the model runs
## without it and the table says so, rather than returning nothing.
pick_tiv <- function(data) {
  for (cc in c("TIV_cat", "MRI_TIV", "MRI_TIV.x", "MRI_TIV.y"))
    if (cc %in% names(data) && any(!is.na(num_safe(data[[cc]])))) return(cc)
  NA_character_
}

fit_saa <- function(outcome, data, tiv_col) {
  need <- c(outcome, "saa_any_pos", "SEX", "age_at_sample")
  if (!all(need %in% names(data))) return(NULL)
  use_tiv <- !is.na(tiv_col) && tiv_col %in% names(data)
  if (use_tiv) {
    data[[tiv_col]] <- num_safe(data[[tiv_col]])
    need <- c(need, tiv_col)
  }
  d <- data %>% select(all_of(need)) %>% drop_na()
  if (nrow(d) < 12 || n_distinct(d$saa_any_pos) < 2) return(NULL)
  d[[outcome]] <- as.numeric(scale(d[[outcome]]))     # SD units, comparable
  d$saa_any_pos <- factor(d$saa_any_pos, levels = c("Negative", "Positive"))
  fml <- if (use_tiv)
    sprintf("`%s` ~ saa_any_pos + SEX + age_at_sample + `%s`", outcome, tiv_col)
  else
    sprintf("`%s` ~ saa_any_pos + SEX + age_at_sample", outcome)
  m <- lm(as.formula(fml), data = d)
  rn <- "saa_any_posPositive"
  if (!rn %in% rownames(summary(m)$coefficients)) return(NULL)
  s <- summary(m)$coefficients[rn, ]; ci <- confint(m)[rn, ]
  tibble(n = nrow(d), n_pos = sum(d$saa_any_pos == "Positive"),
         TIV_adjusted = use_tiv,
         Beta = s["Estimate"], CI_l = ci[1], CI_u = ci[2], P = s["Pr(>|t|)"])
}

run_pipeline <- function(data, prefix, label) {
  if (is.null(data) || !nrow(data)) return(NULL)
  tiv_col <- pick_tiv(data)
  res <- map_dfr(STRUCTS, function(s) {
    r <- fit_saa(paste0(prefix, s), data, tiv_col)
    if (is.null(r)) return(NULL)
    bind_cols(tibble(Structure = s, Pipeline = label), r)
  })
  if (!nrow(res)) return(NULL)
  res$Q_all <- p.adjust(res$P, "BH")
  ap <- res$Structure %in% APRIORI
  res$Q_apriori <- NA_real_
  if (any(ap)) res$Q_apriori[ap] <- p.adjust(res$P[ap], "BH")
  res
}

res_fs  <- run_pipeline(img_fs,  "FS_",  "FreeSurfer (aseg)")
res_cat <- run_pipeline(img_cat, "CAT_", "CAT12 (Hammers)")
img_res <- bind_rows(res_fs, res_cat)

if (nrow(img_res)) {
  write.csv(img_res, file.path(results_path, "Subcortical_SAA.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  img_res %>%
    transmute(Pipeline, Structure, n, n_pos, TIV_adjusted, Beta = round(Beta, 3),
              `95% CI` = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", CI_l, CI_u),
              p = round(P, 4), `q (BH/7)` = round(Q_all, 3),
              `q (a priori/3)` = ifelse(is.na(Q_apriori), "—", round(Q_apriori, 3))) %>%
    arrange(Pipeline, p) %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "Pipeline") %>%
    tab_header(title = md("**Subcortical volume by SAA status**"),
               subtitle = "Adjusted for age at sampling, sex and TIV. Volumes z-scored within sample, so β is in SD units.") %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_fill(color = "#E0E0E0"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
              locations = cells_row_groups()) %>%
    opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "blue")
} else {
  cat("No imaging file found, or too few subjects with both imaging and SAA status.\n",
      sprintf("CAT12 present: %s. FreeSurfer aseg present: %s.", have_cat12, have_aseg))
}
```

```{r imaging-forest, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5, eval=nrow(img_res)>0}
sig_colour <- function(P, Q, Beta)
  ifelse(!is.na(Q) & Q < .05, ifelse(Beta > 0, "#0072B2", "#D55E00"),
         ifelse(!is.na(P) & P < .05, "#000000", "gray60"))
pf <- img_res %>% mutate(col = sig_colour(P, Q_all, Beta),
                         Structure = factor(Structure, levels = rev(STRUCTS)))
ggplot(pf, aes(Beta, Structure, colour = col)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "gray60") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_l, xmax = CI_u), height = .22, linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ Pipeline) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  labs(title = "Subcortical volume vs SAA status",
       x = "β (SAA+ vs SAA−, SD units)", y = "",
       caption = "Blue/orange = FDR q<0.05 over 7 structures; black = nominal p<0.05; grey = ns") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r pipeline-agreement, fig.width=6, fig.height=4.5, eval=(!is.null(res_fs) && !is.null(res_cat))}
## Same subjects, same model, two segmentations: does the effect replicate?
cmp <- inner_join(res_fs  %>% select(Structure, Beta_FS = Beta, P_FS = P),
                  res_cat %>% select(Structure, Beta_CAT = Beta, P_CAT = P),
                  by = "Structure")
shared <- intersect(img_fs$NHC, img_cat$NHC)
ggplot(cmp, aes(Beta_FS, Beta_CAT, label = Structure)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
  geom_point(size = 3, colour = "#0072B2") +
  geom_text(nudge_y = .04, size = 3.2) +
  labs(title = "Cross-pipeline agreement",
       subtitle = sprintf("%d subjects imaged in both pipelines; r = %.2f",
                          length(shared),
                          suppressWarnings(cor(cmp$Beta_FS, cmp$Beta_CAT,
                                               use = "complete.obs"))),
       x = "β, FreeSurfer (aseg)", y = "β, CAT12 (Hammers)",
       caption = "Points on the dashed line replicate across segmentations.")
```

# Summary of methodological choices

```{r summary-notes, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf("
- **Merge.** Clinical visits paired with the biofluid sample closest in time (`visit_date`, not the baseline date). %s
- **Long-format REDCap.** Subject-level fields carried down within NHC before collapsing to one row per subject, so core symptoms and visit scores coexist.
- **Reading.** `guess_max = Inf`, without which readxl types the visit-level columns from the empty enrolment rows and discards their data.
- **SAA recoding.** Anchored patterns; every raw level is printed above for verification. Indeterminate results excluded (n = %d), not folded into either group.
- **Combined cohort.** Own-site result preferred, Munich as fallback — discordant pairs are no longer silently coded Positive. This cohort contains the Sant Pau cohort, so the two tables are not independent.
- **Plausibility limits.** Values outside the scale range are set to NA and counted, which is what removes the impossible Mayo (mean 21, SD 62 on a 0–4 scale) and UPDRS values seen previously.
- **Tests.** Rank-based for continuous variables, Fisher for categorical, with SMD alongside the mean/risk difference and BH-FDR across each biomarker panel.
- **Coverage gate.** Assays with fewer than %d observations per group are omitted rather than printed as `NA (NA)`.
- **Imaging.** Both segmentations on the same subjects, volumes z-scored so structures of different size share an axis, with an a priori 3-structure family alongside the 7-structure FDR.
", merge_note, n_indet, MIN_PER_GROUP))
```
